name: ALCE
description: ALCE is the first benchmark for automatic evaluation of large language models' ability to generate text with citations. It includes a diverse set of questions and retrieval corpora, requiring end-to-end systems to retrieve supporting evidence and generate answers with citations. The benchmark uses automatic metrics for fluency, correctness, and citation quality, which correlate strongly with human judgments.
reputation: A well-known recent benchmark for citation-grounded generation that has been used to study faithfulness and citation quality in LLM outputs.
notes: Highlights the challenge of citation-supported generation and the need for better retrievers and long-context LLMs.
